name: live-demo
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). The live demo: discovery, automatic routing, backup next hops, local failover (T1 + T2) telemetry, the controller heartbeat and C's bounded buffer with replay are on; the controller learns only through the gateway. The scenario duration is ignored by the live runtime, which runs indefinitely; presenter controls change the simulated environment.
